name: Summerscape Day Camp
street_address: Rocky Hill High School, 50 Chapin Avenue
description_short: A town day camp at Rocky Hill High School for children from age 4 (pre-K) through grade 5, open to residents and non-residents, 8:30 am to 4 pm in weekly sessions. Campers have weekly themes and spirit days, grades 1 to 5 swim in the school's indoor pool, and grades 3 to 5 pick a weekly elective. The camp stays on site.
swim_waterfront_notes: Grades 1 to 5 swim in the Rocky Hill High School indoor pool with certified lifeguards; pre-K and kindergarten have water activities instead. Life jackets case by case.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Summer 2026 handbook (updated 2/24/26): seven weekly sessions June 22 to August 7. Open to children at least 4 years old by June 22, 2026 entering pre-K through grade 5 in 2026 to 27, residents and non-residents. Regular hours 8:30 am to 4 pm; early program 7:30 to 8:30 and late program 4 to 6 pm at extra cost. No field trips for the day camp, so transportation recorded as none. Campers bring snack and lunch. The handbook gives no fee. The handbook lists Week 2 as June 29 to July 3 and does not say whether camp meets on the July 3 holiday.

source.title: Summerscape Day Camp Parent Handbook, Summer 2026

changes: Used the 2026 season: no 2027 information is posted. The 2026 fee is not posted anywhere I could read, so no price recorded.
Summerscape Teen Camp and CIT have their own handbooks and are not included.
